content.stem: 应实施以下哪些措施来促进不同风险管理职能之间的协作，以增强组织的反金融犯罪(AFC)计划？（选择三项。）

options.A: 建立强大的持续威胁情报共享框架
options.B: 要求高级管理层对AFC失效负责
options.C: 在风险管理职能之间建立奖励计划，以鼓励主动控制措施
options.D: 开发关于AFC风险、管理策略及相关技术的跨职能培训项目
options.E: 建立共同的衡量标准和关键绩效指标

content.stem_en: Which measures should be implemented to facilitate collaboration among different risk management functions to enhance an organization's anti-financial crime (AFC) program? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Establish a robust framework for continuous threat intelligence sharing.
options_en.B: Have senior management accountability for AFC failures.
options_en.C: Establish a reward program among risk management functions to encourage proactive controls.
options_en.D: Develop cross-functional training programs on AFC risks, management strategies, and related technologies.
options_en.E: Develop common metrics and key performance indicators.
